rule: Replace property tax is several different fiscal problems. Do not collapse URT, additional school millage, county, municipal, special-district, and debt-service layers.

sources.label: AACD / DFA Assessment Coordination Division — 2026 Annual Report (2025 taxable values)
AACD 2025 Millage Report (2026 Collections) — state averages of per-county averages
sources.structure_note: School Total may include M&O and Debt Service. City Total may include general, fire/police pension, library, bond, park, other. County Total may include general, road, library, hospital, community college, other.

sources.label: BLR Funding Overview — 98% URT local foundation
Association of Arkansas Counties — approximate property-tax distribution shares (contextual, not a DFA table)

collection_factor_vs_urt.note: Used only to scale ILLUSTRATIVE mill×AV estimates toward collection-like dollars. Not an official collection rate for every layer.

layers.name: School Uniform Rate of Tax (25 mills)
layers.method: BLR foundation table — estimated local taxes 98% of URT × assessment (2024–25)
layers.volatility: Relatively stable vs IIT; assessment-cycle and collection-rate sensitive
layers.incidence: Property owners (homeowners, businesses, ag, utilities); liquidity hardship possible even when asset-rich

layers.name: Additional school millage above URT (avg school 38.52 − 25 = 13.52 mills)
layers.method: State-average school millage above 25 × 2025 taxable AV, scaled by URT collection factor
layers.recipient: School districts — additional M&O and/or debt service (mixed; statewide debt split NEE)
layers.legal_dependency: Statutory / local voter-approved millages above constitutional URT
layers.incidence: Same property base as URT; local rate variation high
layers.note: Debt-service mills are embedded in School Total in the millage book; statewide M&O vs bond split not yet inventory-bound.

layers.name: School debt-service millage (subset of school total)
layers.method: Present in millage book School Other Bond columns at district level; statewide aggregation not completed this slice
layers.legal_dependency: Local voter-approved bonds / millages; contractual debt obligations
layers.note: Must not be retired casually — debt covenants may require dedicated millage until bonds mature.

layers.name: County millage (state avg 4.17 mills)
layers.method: State-average county millage × 2025 taxable AV × URT collection factor
layers.recipient: Counties — general, road, library, hospital, community college, other (mixed)
layers.legal_dependency: Statutory / quorum court levies within constitutional/statutory caps

layers.name: Municipal millage (state avg city millage 7.93 — NOT statewide AV-weighted)
layers.alt_method: If school layers ~$2.469B ≈ 79% of property tax (AAC share context), municipalities ≈ 7% → ~$219M
layers.recipient: Cities — general, fire/police pension, library, bonds, parks, other
layers.legal_dependency: Statutory / city council levies; some voter-approved
layers.incidence: Municipal property base only — full-AV scaling overstates; prefer share method or parcel inventory
layers.note: City millage averages are averages of city rates, not a statewide effective rate on all taxable value.

layers.name: Special districts / other entities (~1% contextual share)
layers.recipient: Special districts and other local entities

replacement_burden_summary_usd.note: URT is the only property layer with primary foundation-dollar bind. Other layers are structural estimates pending full millage×assessment×collections inventory. Debt-service dollars remain inside school-additional until split.
